body:
Build a desktop reading queue

Implements the approved design. Live release has not begun.

Linear: [SAC-245](https://linear.app/sachinkundu/issue/SAC-245/build-a-desktop-reading-queue)

Approved Proposal and Specs: [PR #40](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/pull/40)

Approved design: [PR #41](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/pull/41)

Preview: [Open the web app](https://b4729f5d.deos-preview-6788ae86271dbb20.pages.dev) (built before the latest changes)

Proof:

1. Kindred and Dune begin in To read, with the global counts showing 2, 0, and 0.

   ![Kindred and Dune begin in To read, with the global counts showing 2, 0, and 0.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/c6f1b2305ff1ce2e9526cbb0c0c28042e9379f5cb4ecf4721846d123b420ac48.png)

2. Moving Kindred to Reading updates its badge and changes the global counts to 1, 1, and 0.

   ![Moving Kindred to Reading updates its badge and changes the global counts to 1, 1, and 0.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/661a6495e9fe02888466db586c3e5e7ead143bb98b19601ba27380047ab867a5.png)

3. Moving Kindred to Finished updates its badge and changes the global counts to 1, 0, and 1.

   ![Moving Kindred to Finished updates its badge and changes the global counts to 1, 0, and 1.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/9b39c50e76f98bd2f615647bdbb4afd9e2e3702fa60d66659b003160ea89eb58.png)

4. Moving Kindred back to To read restores counts of 2, 0, and 0 while preserving book order.

   ![Moving Kindred back to To read restores counts of 2, 0, and 0 while preserving book order.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/233de352bff033ba9f311f8550440f7bc03807c4e5b24d4a6784ca10359e9f5c.png)

5. A blank title shows the inline Add a title error and leaves the saved Kindred row unchanged.

   ![A blank title shows the inline Add a title error and leaves the saved Kindred row unchanged.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/91d035728a0e1c38061361f5b2f8bcd9cdd5c5e3f26804ae4119adbed2065b61.png)

6. The selected Reading filter shows only Kindred while global counts still include The Dispossessed in To read.

   ![The selected Reading filter shows only Kindred while global counts still include The Dispossessed in To read.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/cb895a45bfe81ca3a16c27ea9cc290715412f89514f2ac196c487b1ce45730bf.png)

7. The selected Finished filter shows its explicit empty state while the global To read and Reading counts remain visible and unchanged.

   ![The selected Finished filter shows its explicit empty state while the global To read and Reading counts remain visible and unchanged.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/f42bceb0e5915544c919a9c67c77bedb5b88b56ad66f69cf8639f05bd7fba1e3.png)

8. A blank author edit shows the inline Add an author error without committing the draft.

   ![A blank author edit shows the inline Add an author error without committing the draft.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/2343239a451734ab1dfb386cb62602441c5e4130dbee382ebbe7c316093b06ea.png)

9. After correcting the rejected edit, Dune Messiah still shows Frank Herbert and Reading with the error cleared.

   ![After correcting the rejected edit, Dune Messiah still shows Frank Herbert and Reading with the error cleared.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/37be24401a22a3c889dc6393cb60c732c7303e20bbe83294f0dcf628a03fd75c.png)

10. Three saved books occupy Finished, Reading, and To read with one global count in each status.

    ![Three saved books occupy Finished, Reading, and To read with one global count in each status.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/1c0e4eaf13cff0f9f25a9c62b9006ca414e0d243aa39cd00c4a02147ab46d5f8.png)

11. Deleting Dune removes its row and reduces only the Reading count to zero.

    ![Deleting Dune removes its row and reduces only the Reading count to zero.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/e6b436885a7c304a435e2b005fcd808a77dd344214c9609b190cf2b35c8fca94.png)

12. After refresh, Kindred and The Dispossessed reload in order with their statuses and counts, and Dune stays deleted.

    ![After refresh, Kindred and The Dispossessed reload in order with their statuses and counts, and Dune stays deleted.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/cb8375871d874196e63f79009b257b5cfd13075aa331446ba4821097277771ef.png)

13. After refresh, both literal markup-looking text and the wrapped long title reload from browser storage.

    ![After refresh, both literal markup-looking text and the wrapped long title reload from browser storage.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/images/81fbb0356df16d3a2a44b955561e1da884aaa5bfc2e790af6bf947c913b27273.png)

This is the [Showboat file](https://github.com/sachinkundu/deos-sample-project/blob/9b9b0fec64c3af3822831324f6d6d13d5a60f1ec/showboat.md).
